document.cue: Describe a time when you noticed a pollution or waste problem in your area.

text: I'd like to describe something I noticed last spring while I was cycling along a small river near my town. I'd gone there many times before, but that day I was shocked by how much rubbish had accumulated on the banks, mainly plastic bottles, bags and some old tyres.

The problem seemed to be getting worse every year, partly because people came for picnics and left their waste behind, and partly because the nearby street had no proper bins. After I posted some photos on social media, a local group of students suggested organising a clean-up. About thirty of us turned up on a Saturday morning with gloves and bags, and in four hours we collected more than fifty bags of rubbish. The city council agreed to provide a container and later installed several bins along the path. I think what made the biggest difference was that people saw the situation with their own eyes.

At first I felt angry and a bit helpless, because it seemed too big a problem for one person. However, once we started working together, I felt much more optimistic. It was tiring but really satisfying to see the riverbank clean again. What struck me most was how many people were willing to help once somebody took the initiative. Since then, I've been taking a bag with me on my walks, and I've noticed that the place stays cleaner than before, which gives me hope.

tips.en: The structure presents several causes elegantly.
tips.example: partly because people came for picnics and left their waste behind, and partly because the nearby street had no proper bins

tips.en: What struck me most highlights the key impression.
tips.kk: What struck me most басты әсерді бөліп көрсетеді.
tips.ru: What struck me most выделяет главное впечатление.
tips.example: What struck me most was how many people were willing to help

tips.en: At first … However shows a change of feeling.
tips.kk: At first … However сезім өзгерісін көрсетеді.
tips.ru: At first … However показывает перемену чувств.
tips.example: At first I felt angry and a bit helpless

note.en: Names the place and describes what the speaker noticed.
note.kk: Орынды атап, әңгімешінің нені байқағанын сипаттайды.
note.ru: Называет место и описывает, что именно заметил рассказчик.

note.en: Explains the causes and how it was solved: social media, a clean-up, council help.

note.ru: Объясняет причины проблемы и как её решили: соцсети, уборка, помощь города.
